decision_basis: Project owner directed the software architect to provide and adopt the best engineering estimate in place of a separate accountable target-approval gate.

authority.execution_owners: the owner roles recorded on each accepted target

conditions: These are engineering planning targets, not customer-facing service commitments or an approved business forecast.
Managed PostgreSQL, browser, report, file, and object-store measurements may tighten or relax a target only through a dated amendment retaining this baseline.
Legal retention, residency, privacy, and budget decisions remain with their actual accountable authorities.
Review occurs by 2026-12-15 or earlier on a material workload, provider, region, topology, or product-scope change.
